$comment: CMP-11 metric contract: what the workers emit (as CloudWatch EMF) and the alarms watch. A worker part emits exactly these names; the alarms in alarms.tf.json reference them.

completeReportLag.name: CompleteReportLagDays
completeReportLag.description: Emitted once a minute by the report worker: whole UTC days between today and the report date of the latest report published complete (incomplete and not-generated days do not count); 99 when none exists. Healthy is 1 after the 02:00 UTC run, 2 before it.
